title: How to play Nine Men's Morris in 90 seconds
text:
The whole game in about 90 seconds, shown on Millfall's own board: placing, moving, flying, what a mill is, and how a match ends. Every scene is a real match; both sides are played by the game's own AI.

Video: https://youtu.be/BR3qphgTVRY

Millfall on the Microsoft Store (Windows PC): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHQ64JTDQV2?cid=rd

title: Which death is slowest? Shrink, meteor or polymorph - three spells from one match, ranked
text:
Three spell executions from one AI-vs-AI match in the Moss Grove, ranked by how long the execution takes (measured in-engine): shrink, meteor, polymorph. Both sides are played by the game's own AI.
